mustFix.title: The remainder inventory still classifies non-object top level as CC-5 and therefore does not fully land G21FXV3-M1
mustFix.claimUnderReview: v4 says it lands G21FXV3-M1 by removing non-object-top-level from CC-5, says nonObjectTopLevelClassifiedAsCc5 is false, and makes classification of non-object top level as CC-5 an explicit failsIf condition.
primaryEvidence: $.whatIsNotAuthored[16] is exactly 'CC-5 non-object top level'. In this inventory, the 'CC-5' prefix is a class label: the neighboring entries are 'CC-5 prefix exactly at the operative bound', 'CC-5 prefix far over the operative bound', 'CC-5 truncated bodies', 'CC-5 invalid UTF-8', 'CC-5 duplicate members', 'CC-5 unknown members', 'CC-5 floats', 'CC-5 negative integers', and 'CC-5 over-uint53 integers'. 'Not authored' negates authored status, not class membership. The entry therefore preserves non-object top level as an unauthored CC-5 injection.

The closed c50a79fe... control-protocol contract separates RF-2 coverage from CC-5 membership. $.capabilityEnvelope.refusalFamilies.families[1].covers includes non-object top level, while $.hostileDualChannelConformance.classes[4].intent omits it. v4 correctly states that separation at $.controlFrameEncoding.cc5ClassificationRule, making the remainder entry an internal contradiction rather than an ambiguity in the source authority.

$.failsIf[6] says the artifact fails if 'non-object top level is classified as CC-5'. The remainder inventory performs exactly that classification. The subject thus fails its own explicit acceptance condition on its frozen bytes.

$.remainderAfterThisCorpus and $.proposedLaterWork[1] carry 'remaining CC-5 injections' into a later authoring/remasurement cycle. Because whatIsNotAuthored is the artifact's concrete inventory of those remaining injections, retaining 'CC-5 non-object top level' leaves a path for a later cycle to re-author the same out-of-class case under CC-5 even though the active v4 catalog removed it.

The active authoredCatalog itself is repaired: it contains only length-prefix-0 and prefix-one-over-prehandshake, both expressly present in the closed CC-5 intent. The defect is the contradictory remainder classification, not either frozen v4 payload.
mustFix.impact: The central purpose of v4 is to land G21FXV3-M1 and prevent RF-2 membership from being mistaken for CC-5 membership. Recording v4 with this remainder inventory would declare the finding landed on the active catalog while preserving the rejected classification as future CC-5 fixture work. That makes the lineage disposition and summary false, violates an explicit failsIf, and can propagate the same class expansion into the next corpus or leftover-join. Because the contradiction is on the load-bearing repair and remainder-accounting surface, it is MUST-FIX rather than editorial.
mustFix.requiredRemedy: Do not record this frozen v4. Issue a successor that removes 'CC-5 non-object top level' from the CC-5 remainder inventory. If retaining a historical non-authoring note is useful, label it unambiguously as the rejected v3 RF-2 non-object payload and explicitly state that it is not a CC-5 member; do not place it among remaining CC-5 injections. Recheck appliesFindingsOf, failsIf, summary, whatIsNotAuthored, and later-work remainder text as one consistent classification surface. Preserve the two correct v4 fixture byte sequences, the frozen v3 split, DR-102 SATISFIED, DR-114 and DR-133 OPEN, G21 unexecuted and not QUALIFIED, required-now 28, OBL-G21-FX-AUTHORING open, leftover-join.v9 current and unmoved, and no implementation authorization.

decision: REJECT — 1 MUST-FIX, 0 SHOULD-FIX. Custody passes: the subject remains 0c2084b1... mode 0444; the fixtures remain df3f6198... and 76cc5805... mode 0444; every cited digest reproduces; v3 is accurately pinned as Split; HEAD and last heading remain D-244; required-now remains 28; protected files are unchanged; G21 was not executed. The active v4 catalog correctly replaces the rejected non-object payload with the closed CC-5 pre-handshake one-over prefix 00010001. The repair is nevertheless internally incomplete: whatIsNotAuthored[16] still says 'CC-5 non-object top level', preserving the rejected case as an unauthored CC-5 injection. That contradicts the classification rule, summary, appliesFindingsOf disposition, and the artifact's own failsIf. Recording v4 would therefore carry G21FXV3-M1 into future remainder work while claiming it landed.
